coverLetter:
Hi there,

I saw your project posting and would love to help you build and refine your web application!

As a skilled Full-Stack React & Node.js Developer, I have extensive experience with building responsive user interfaces, integrating RESTful APIs, and implementing clean database schemas.

Why work with me?

Strong experience with React, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js/Express.

Fast delivery, clean & reusable code, and great communication.

High attention to detail and UI/UX design patterns.

I am ready to start immediately and deliver quality results for your team. Looking forward to discussing the project further!

Best regards,

Ghofran
